text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx at gateway-edge: 502/504 rate jumped from 0.3% -> 6.7% in 4m. Targets: /v1/generate and /v1/embed. Triggered auto-pager.

sanjay: picking this up — oncall is me. seeing latency climb in eu-west first. any customer-facing pages?

maya: +1 from dashboards. Error breakdown from logs: 70% 504 (upstream timeout), 25% 502 (upstream reset), 5% other. Biggest sources: internal proxy pool 12, LB route r-eu-01.

oliver: reproduced a few failed curl requests: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` shows `upstream timed out (110)` after 15s.

sanjay: thanks. quick mitigation options: 1) enable fallback routing to dedicated-runtime cluster for affected routes 2) lower gateway upstream timeouts temporarily 3) open circuit-breaker for r-eu-01. Which one is fastest?

tess: fastest is fallback routing + reduce upstream timeout to 5s. I'll prep a rollout.

liam: adding context: we've got the new auth-proxy rollout finishing in eu-west ~10m ago. Could be related. auth-proxy calls are on the request path for /v1/generate.

maya: correlating traces — yes, median auth-proxy latency jumped x10 and DNS resolution shows a handful of backends in the pool failing healthchecks.

sanjay: ok do fallback routing to runtime-fallback-eu and flip it for /v1/generate /v1/embed. Tess, can you run the routing patch? I'll set a temporary circuit-breaker for r-eu-01.

tess: pushing patch now (edge-router config):
```
- route: /v1/generate
  cluster: edge-primary-eu
+ route: /v1/generate
  cluster: runtime-fallback-eu
  header: x-incident-override: true
```
Rolling to 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 minutes.

oliver: applied circuit-breaker to r-eu-01: max_conns=100 -> 30, retry=0.

maya: after 2m: overall 5xx rate dropped to 1.1%. 504s fell by ~85%. Latency also improved for affected routes. Customer impact reduced. :thumbsup:

sanjay: good. leaving tracing enabled and increasing log retention for this window. Opening customer channel note: "We saw transient errors affecting a subset of EU requests between 21:20-21:35 UTC; mitigation applied, investigating root cause."

liam: next steps: revert auth-proxy rollout in eu-west, run healthcheck sweep, and add circuit-breaker health threshold to prevent cascade. Will coordinate with infra.

tess: evacuation complete — routing fully on runtime-fallback-eu at 21:24 UTC. No data loss.

maya: collecting detailed span samples into /tmp/incidents/5250004321-spans.log for postmortem.

sanjay: handoff to liam for 21:40 -> 23:40 shift. If anything reoccurs ping @sanjay. Creating incident ticket IDC-2026-0123 and marking severity: P1 -> P2 as customer impact limited.

incident-bot: Pager cleared for oncall(sanjay). Incident ticket IDC-2026-0123 created.

liam: acknowledged handoff. I'll follow up with auth-proxy revert and join postmortem tomorrow.

sanjay: thanks team — summary: auth-proxy rollout caused upstream timeouts which cascaded at gateway; immediate fix: route to runtime-fallback and circuit-breaker applied. Postmortem + remediation planned. End of thread.
